title: Set Streamlit app source
description: Create a new version of a Streamlit app from free-text source, and set it as the active version. Use it for a new app or a full rewrite only: it replaces every file, so any file you leave out is lost. To change an existing app, read it with streamlit-apps-get-source and patch it with streamlit-apps-edit-source. The source becomes the root app.py; optional extra text files (helper modules, CSV, JSON) go in `files` and binary files (Parquet, images) go base64-encoded in `assets`, so no zip upload is needed. If the app is running, its sandbox is stopped; call streamlit-apps-start afterwards to serve the new version. Use posthog_apps.query("<HogQL>") inside the app to read PostHog data as a pandas DataFrame. There is no way to add pip dependencies — only packages baked into the sandbox image are importable.

methodDocumentation.text: Create an app version from source code

Create a new version of a Streamlit app from free-text source, and set it as the active version. Use it for a new app or a full rewrite only: it replaces every file, so any file you leave out is lost. To change an existing app, read it with streamlit-apps-get-source and patch it with streamlit-apps-edit-source. The source becomes the root app.py; optional extra text files (helper modules, CSV, JSON) go in `files` and binary files (Parquet, images) go base64-encoded in `assets`, so no zip upload is needed. If the app is running, its sandbox is stopped; call streamlit-apps-start afterwards to serve the new version. Use posthog_apps.query("<HogQL>") inside the app to read PostHog data as a pandas DataFrame. There is no way to add pip dependencies — only packages baked into the sandbox image are importable.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription: The complete Python source for the app's root app.py (a Streamlit script, e.g. starting with `import streamlit as st`). Sent as plain text.

layers.text: Full Python source for the Streamlit app's root app.py file, as free text (max 1 MB). Becomes a new version and is set as the active version.
The complete Python source for the app's root app.py (a Streamlit script, e.g. starting with `import streamlit as st`). Sent as plain text.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription: Optional extra text files keyed by project-relative path (e.g. `utils.py`, `data/config.json`), each value the file's full text. Paths must not be `app.py` and must not contain `..`. The app process does not run inside its own directory, so open them via `Path(__file__).parent / "data/config.json"`.

layers.text: Extra text files to ship next to app.py, keyed by project-relative path (for example 'utils.py' or 'data/config.json'), each as plain text (max 1 MB).

Optional extra text files keyed by project-relative path (e.g. `utils.py`, `data/config.json`), each value the file's full text. Paths must not be `app.py` and must not contain `..`. The app process does not run inside its own directory, so open them via `Path(__file__).parent / "data/config.json"`.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription: Optional extra binary files keyed by project-relative path (e.g. `data/events.parquet`), each value the file's bytes as standard base64. Same path rules as `files`. Keep them small: the whole call is sent as JSON, so a large file costs tokens on every set-source.
